verdict.rationale: Evidence shows Gemini CLI can automate git-related operational tasks like querying pull requests and handling complex rebases, and its GitHub Action can do automated PR reviews and issue triage, but there's no explicit documentation of the agent staging changes, writing commit messages, creating branches, or opening new pull requests itself. Missing for 10: explicit commit-message generation, branch creation, and PR-opening workflow evidence, plus independent confirmation these work reliably.
